name: Technologist Scholar Archetype
body:
Technologist scholars come from more advanced societies where technology tends to be more important than magic.

Class Skills

Disable Device (Dex) is a class skill for you, but Use Magic Device (Cha) is not.

This feature modifies class skills.

Technologist Savvy

At 1st level, you gain Technologist as a bonus feat, as well as proficiency with all firearms. Furthermore, you can use inspiration for free when using the Disable Device skill to arm or disarm technological devices.

This feature replaces one of the two basic study abilities normally gained at 1st level.

Technologist Studies

You cannot choose from the studies of Arcana, Astrology, or Ravenry. Instead, you gain access to the Computer Science and Cybertech studies (see below), which can only be selected by tech scholars.

This feature modifies scholar studies.

Computer Science

Associated Skill Disable Device (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Datapad (Ex)

You gain a small, handheld device known as a datapad. Your datapad is a computer with a tier equal to 1/2 your ranks in the Disable Device skill (minimum tier 1). You can use it to connect remotely if within range of a wireless communication network. If you are connected to an Infosphere, you can take 20 on any Knowledge check covered by that Infosphere. Your datapad also allows you to use recharge or technomancy at will by expending 1 point of inspiration; these are exceptional abilities when you use your datapad. Your datapad has hardness and hit points equal to 8 + 2/tier. It is self-charging while in your care, but ceasing functioning 24 hours after leaving your possession. If lost or destroyed, you can replace your datapad with 8 hours of work and materials costing 100 gp/tier. You can have only one functioning datapad at a time.

Associated Technique
Hacking Technique (Ex)

When using this technique, you ignore 1 point of DR or energy resistance (your choice) that the opponent you have studied with this technique has. The amount of DR or energy resistance ignored increases by 1 at 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 7 points at 18th level. Double the amount of DR or energy resistance ignored if your opponent is a technological creature, such as one with the android subtype or robot subtype.

Advanced Study Abilities
Electromagnetic Protection (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Datapad study ability, scholar level 6th.

So long as your datapad is in your possession (held or stowed), it provides you with resistance to electricity equal to your number of ranks in the Disable Device skill.

In addition, once every 1d4 rounds you can use discharge by expending 1 point of inspiration; this is an exceptional ability instead of a spell-like one. You must have your datapad to activate this ability, and your datapad is always unaffected by the discharge.

Plasma Adaptor (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Datapad study ability, scholar level 8th.

Your datapad becomes fitted with a directed energy forced plasma particle beam emitter, allowing you to use it as a one-handed technological firearm with the characteristics of a laser pistol. The plasma containment battery chamber automatically recharges and has a daily usage capacity with a number of charges equal to your number of ranks in the Disable Device skill.

Robot Hacker (Ex/Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Datapad study ability, scholar level 5th.

You gain Robot’s Bane as a bonus feat.

You do not need to meet the usual prerequisites for this feat. You base the bonuses from the feat on your ranks in Disable Device instead of Knowledge (engineering). In addition, once per day you can expend 1 point of inspiration using your datapad to cast disable construct as a spell-like ability. Use your number of ranks in Disable Device as your caster level and Intelligence as your relevant casting ability score.

Trap Hacker (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Datapad study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain the trapfinding ability of the rogue class, using your datapad to locate and disable traps. Your datapad functions as both an ordinary set of thieves’ tools and as an e-pick that can be used to unlock and disable electronic locks and devices. Its e-pick model type is dependent on your number of ranks in the Disable Device skill, as follows:

Ranks	Model	Bonus
1–3	Brown	+0
4–5	Black	+1
6–7	White	+2
8–9	Gray	+3
10–11	Green	+4
12–13	Red	+5
14–15	Blue	+6
16–17	Orange	+7
18–20	Prismatic	+10
